notes.title: From Burlesque to Bureaucracy!
notes.notes:
[p]Hello! And welcome to Issue 2 of our devlog! Enjoy some pictures from our adventures in the Poconos and sneak preview of some full game milestones![/p][p][/p][h2]Colossal Con East Appearance![/h2][p]From the stage to the dungeon! We had a blast at Colossal Con East in the Poconos in early September! We were invited by a fan and friend to open at one of the burlesque shows! 

Peablossom even made an appearance for the show!

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45576962/10079b7a50a0967b40a56d275809472dcb6b65d8.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]From chants of “Eat the Rich!” to people singing “Solidarity Forever” as we left the stage ♥️We’ll never forget that incredible experience! Thank you to all who made it out![/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45576962/32a69ada9049661d842eb8441a0895e1c8be3c3f.jpg"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45576962/9c378fa71c215d98b7c243a9cc1be2a7c786dbe8.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]Not only did our number one fan invite us to open for his show, but he also cosplayed Franny! 😭
[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45576962/bfe51a1618189312f5c0b78b90e837c9738c8d22.jpg"][/img][/p][h2]Full Game Milestones[/h2][p]So much to do and so little time! We’ve been adding so much to the full game, take a look at things to come[/p][list][*][p]💾 [b]Saving & Cloud Saves[/b][/p][list][*][p]We’ve implemented saving and cloud saves[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]🧩 [b]New Tile Mechanics[/b] 🥚🪓🤔[/p][list][*][p]Each department introduces mechanics unique to that area[/p][/*][*][p]Like in world one when you get to be customer facing![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45576962/8e698703e9b178e2464e0e1822a87cd3d4483ca6.gif"][/img][/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]✍️ [b]Tons of Writing[/b][/p][list][*][p]Zak has been crushing it! He has the drafts out for the first two departments and they're hilarious and heartbreaking[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]🎨 [b]Employee Designs Finalized[/b][/p][list][*][p]This is a huge milestone! Now that their in game designs have been finalized it makes building out cutscenes so much faster[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45576962/ecb95f941f6b105aea07f88e288ed5d7aa5ab6a2.png"][/img][/p][list][*][p][b]🎮Controls Experimentation[/b][/p][list][*][p]We’ve been listening to feedback! A few of you found clockwise/counterclockwise controls clunky for mouse, so we’re testing a click-and-drag style rotation. Join our beta test and let us know what you think!
[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][h2]If you wanna have input on the input[/h2][p][b][u][url="https://discord.gg/WcMeTM6HSH"]Join our Discord[/url][/u][/b] to get access to our beta branches to test the new input controls! Or to just join in to hang out! [/p][p]
Much love,[/p][p]Cephalopod Ink Team 🦑🐙[/p]

notes.title: Breaking Locks & Breaking the Silence!
notes.notes:
[h2]Timeline Changes[/h2][p][b][i]We’re pushing back our launch date from August to later this Fall.[/i][/b]
[/p][p]We’ve been hard at work this summer post PAX, TooManyGames, SteamNextFest, and launching our demo! It's been super busy and as part of that we haven’t had many breaks. We don’t want to commit to a specific date until we hit a few internal milestones, and get a better idea of a healthy pace for us to develop at. We’ve been so excited for all of our events we were burning the candle at both ends. The goal of this venture is to build a sustainable business and not just kill ourselves to ship [b][i]SOMETHING.[/i][/b][/p][p][/p][p]We appreciate y'alls understanding and are looking forward to sharing more of Hoard’s LLC as soon as we can ♥️ Here’s some fun updates that hopefully show we’re still working and still really care about sharing what we can with y’all.[/p][p] [/p][h2]Demo Update[/h2][p]We’re shipping some quality of life improvements for our demo so y'all can get a peak at what we’ve been working on.[/p][list][*][p]Dialogue Features 💬[/p][list][*][p]Typewriter text effect! ⌨️[/p][list][*][p]The text mooooves[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Skip button! ⏭️[/p][list][*][p]No longer need to spam click to get through the dialogue[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Auto-Advance ⏩[/p][list][*][p]You don't want to click to progress dialogue? We got you! You can now toggle auto advance and it’ll progress through the dialogue [/p][/*][*][p]Auto advance disables when you click to progress the story manually[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Log 📋[/p][list][*][p]You got distracted while Franny was talking?? No worries! You can now toggle the Log to see what was just said[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Shadowing non-speaking character 👤[/p][list][*][p]Now the character that isn’t speaking has a slight shadow on them to show they’re not selected[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Snappy Undo ⏪[/p][list][*][p]No more waiting for the tiles to rotate back so you can undo a lot of moves really quickly[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]No more input queuing🧍🧍🧍🧍[/p][list][*][p]You can't click 1000 times and then get stuck waiting for all 1000 rotations to animate. We now disable selection while the gameboard is rotating[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Locks break open on solve 🔓[/p][list][*][p]It was always kind of weird how the locked tiles click together, now they fall off when the dungeon comes together[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]WITNESS The Flashing Lock Tiles 🟥🔒[/p][list][*][p]Locked tiles now flash an angry red when you try to rotate them[/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45576962/a555d9612c04044ef34bebbbcac789a72db937bf.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][/*][/list][h2]Dev Logs[/h2][p]It’s easy for us to get heads down and forget folks are actually interested in the game, so we’re gonna start doing dev logs even if it's just a gif, or doodle, or Katie’s mad ramblings about business plans. We’ll post to Steam a couple times a month. [url="https://discord.gg/WcMeTM6HSH"]You can also join us on Discord![/url][/p]
